headline: COL @ PIT matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is COL 3.49 at PIT 4.77, with a projected total of 8.25. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward COL: COL moved -0.28 runs while PIT moved -0.99, changing the projected margin by +0.71 runs. The projected total fell -1.28, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +9.3%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Jose Quintana has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Oneil Cruz, Konnor Griffin, Troy Johnston, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Billy Cook, Edouard Julien because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
